summary: Created an 11-phase plan discharging DP-2. The plan follows the research report over the task description: the numeric premise route is rejected as non-inductive (the threaded invariant must be structural), and the final-branch transfer is rejected as non-derivable (the residue is consumed at mint time instead). Phase 5 is an explicit go/no-go gate isolating the single unproven step as a standalone lemma before the invariant bulk is built on it.
decisions_made: Threaded invariant is structural (IWorldHist over par/obl/sfor/fire), not a numeric strengthening of IAllNW; the numeric bound nw <= WBound is re-derived as a corollary at each consumption site.
The runtime reuse-check 'none' is consumed at mint time while bPers is current, yielding the snapshot-free residue not(sfor c subset sfor c'); the final-branch transfer is never attempted.

The report's 9-phase decomposition was refined to 11 phases: the residue derivation is hoisted into its own standalone gate phase (Phase 5) stated with all five inputs as explicit hypotheses, so the go/no-go risk is testable before the large IWorldHist threading development is built on it.

intCreatedChain_le stays byte-identical and sorry-free; the new depth bound is a sibling lemma copied from its pigeonhole body, and its docstring records the negative result rather than the lemma being deleted.
Phases 3 and 4 both edit intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat's signature and key induction, so they are placed in different waves and must never be dispatched in parallel.
dead_ends: Restating intFreshMint_preserves_nw with the numeric premise nw < WBound phi0 and threading it: not inductive, since a mint yields nw + 1 <= WBound, not nw + 1 < WBound, which the next mint on the same branch needs.

Supplying intCreatedChain_le's hunb by monotonicity from the runtime check: conjunct 3 runs backwards under branch growth because positive content at x only grows. No monotonicity argument or extra final-branch invariant recovers it.
Bounding the counter by the fuel (nw <= 1 + intFuelExt): provably circular, since intFuelExt must dominate 2 * (intUniverseExt).length and F >= 4(2c+1)(F+1) has no solution in Nat.

Flat pigeonhole over (sfor, obl) pairs without the tree: the reuse check is ancestor-directed and siblings never block each other, so no bound follows. depth x branching is unavoidable and is exactly what WBound's shape encodes.
